A chain of limestone shoals called Adam's Bridge nearly links Sri Lanka to India across the Palk Strait.

evidence.restatement: Sri Lanka is an island country off the south-east coast of India.
The Maldives lie south-west of India; Madagascar lies off south-east Africa and Mauritius east of it.
Adam's Bridge (Rama Setu) is a chain of limestone shoals from Pamban Island in India to Mannar Island in Sri Lanka.

claimResults.note: Strictly the shoals divide the Gulf of Mannar from the Palk Strait and Palk Bay waters to the north-east; reference works describe them as almost linking the two countries across the Palk Strait, so the wording is acceptable.

evidence.restatement: Sri Lanka is an island country off the south-eastern tip of India, across the Palk Strait and the Gulf of Mannar.
The Maldives lie south-west of India; Mauritius and Madagascar lie in the south-western Indian Ocean off south-eastern Africa.
Adam's Bridge (Rama's Bridge) is a chain of limestone shoals between Pamban Island in India and Mannar Island in Sri Lanka, at the edge of the Palk Strait.
